Dialogue.Line: ...I'm back.
It feels like so long ago. When I first arrived here... I didn't even know what I was looking for.
Springtide Meadows. Mirage Plains. Amberwood Forest. And the Pale Snowfields.
Everywhere I went... everyone had something they wanted to protect.
Viridian wanted to protect his people from hunger. Gadriel wanted to keep his region from falling apart. Dhana wanted to preserve everything her people had built.
And Mira... she wanted to understand enough to make the right choice.
None of them wanted to hurt the world. And yet...
They held on so tightly to what they loved... they stopped seeing what it was costing the world.
No. Good intentions don't undo the harm that followed.
Maybe that's what makes all of this so difficult.
I've seen what happens when people depend on these fragments. But I've also seen how much they fear losing them.
If I restore the artifact...
The regions could begin to heal. The Waning might finally recede.
Maybe the artifact could become what Lunaria first intended it to be.
The artifact could restore what was lost... but the world might learn to rely on it all over again.
I could mend the damage without changing what caused it.
But would the world learn to stand on its own?
And if I destroy it...
People would be free to shape what comes next, without the fragments deciding it for them.
Whatever they built afterward would truly belong to them.
So much has been built around their power. Taking it away could bring suffering before anything begins to heal.
Freedom would mean carrying that risk without knowing who might pay the price.
Without the fragments to depend on. Without knowing what comes next.
I wonder... is there really a right answer?
...No. Maybe that's not the question I should be asking.
Lunaria... you entrusted me with this choice. Not because you knew what I would do, but because you believed I could understand.
I don't know what tomorrow will bring. I don't know if everyone will agree with what I choose... and perhaps they won't.
But I've seen this world. I've walked its roads, met its people.
And despite everything... I still believe there's a future worth hoping for.
So... what should I do?
